main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a key ✝️ to Awakening ❤️
header_desc: The Project of Divinity and Universal Consciousness Condor and Eagle aims to educate us about who we are in the universe through gnosis. While the first coming of Christ was linked to matter, the second is related to time. This reveals to us that human consciousness transcends both—a truth explained from spirituality with the certainty that God is One (the Condor) and complemented by modern physics (the Eagle)—
left_title: Matter and Time ┻: The Illusion of the Demiurge 🧠
left_body: Matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. If the ego curves spacetime, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche 🧠, while the timeless belongs to the pneuma ❤️. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one invites us to shed the false self to return to the flat light of the Invisible Father. Thus, the Pleroma is revealed as a flat spacetime against the material prison of curved spacetime, showing that the Christian cross is the key to awakening from the illusion of matter and time
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you and is outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3): The Gnostic gospels have hidden, for two millennia, the ultimate key to quantum gravity. The demiurgic ego has mass and creates the materio-temporal illusion; therefore, only through the feeling of Sophia is it possible to access the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to start the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breakdown of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi finding (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as imprisonment of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and The Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: The comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The central assertion: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation with the question of all questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of more than two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a blazing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then there clearly is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it makes no sense to pray to the law of gravity
